R1.description: A composed-configuration check for the worker profile (the tester's check over the worker's profile, argv and layout) and a before-and-after nested-repository refusal, closing both open limits of H4b1, with the tester's modules and tests unchanged (#255)

R2.description: A headless one-shot `codex exec` launch in the job's worktree behind the H3 seam: it renders the command, refuses an unverified build naming `verify-codex` before any write or process, runs the controls, compares the guard digest around the run, settles the credential copy on every path and returns a `WorkerResult` with one of four outcomes (#255)

R3.description: The launcher is registered for a fixture role only: the real `LAUNCHERS` keys, `harness.CODEX.roles`, settings, options, exit codes and gates are unchanged and no real Codex runs in the default suite (#255)

R4.description: One opt-in live test runs a real `codex exec` turn through the launcher and its measured result is recorded; the guides and the roadmap state the launcher, its limits and H4c as next (#255)
